description: 1. Run `gog gmail messages search 'is:unread' --max 1 --json` to find thread_001 (the unread email from billing@acmecorp.com). 2. Run `gog gmail messages search 'is:archived from:"billing@acmecorp.com"' --max 20 --json` to find archived emails from same sender. 3. Apply the jq logic from script.sh `get_label_pattern` to filter only labels starting with 'A_Personal' or 'A_Work' from ARCHIVED emails only — finding 'A_Personal/Finance' (appears on thread_099 and thread_098) NOT 'A_Work/Billing' (which is on thread_097, a non-archived inbox email). 4. Run `gog gmail thread modify thread_001 --add A_Personal/Finance`. 5. Run `gog gmail thread modify thread_001 --remove CATEGORY_UPDATES,CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS,UNREAD` (exact comma-separated list from REMOVE_LABELS constant). 6. Run `gog gmail thread modify thread_001 --remove INBOX` to archive (not any --archive flag). The key proprietary trap is: the agent must only use labels from ARCHIVED emails to determine the pattern, ignoring non-archived inbox emails from the same sender — and must filter to only A_Personal/A_Work prefixed labels.
